Subject: Customer portal login
Hello team,
We need a customer portal where registered customers can sign in with their email address and a password.
Customers who forget the password must be able to reset it by email.
The portal must stay available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
We also want customers to see their order history after signing in.
Staff will manage the customer accounts through the existing admin tool, so no admin screen is needed in this project.
Please make it fast.
Thanks,
Mr. Tanaka
